Summary: [BE-01] PDQ Parser: CQ-IR Subsheet (Config Key model, block-grouped)
Description:
Parse the CQ-IR subsheet into block-grouped cqIrParameters, mirroring the Phase 1 userInput structure.
Config Key column is the sole parse-trigger: non-empty = parametric row; empty = meta row, skipped.
Value rules: split Response on first ':' (keep left, trim both sides); arrays on ' & '; IDENTIFICATION 'to' -> {min,max}; per-field step-division; INTERVAL enum mapping; TIMEOUT_VALUE nested under CFG_TIMEOUT and padded to 8.
Honour sheet/row/column visibility flags. Single external error code PDQ_INVALID.
Contract: VTF-329.
Tests: extend Cucumber suite (happy / malformed / missing); Phase 1 features must still pass.

Summary: [BE-02] PDQ Parser: ConfigControlTable Subsheet (DP-name literal match) + DT Inputs
Description:
Parse ConfigControlTable into controlTable.trackSections[] (cols A-H) and controlTable.dpTable[] (cols J-M; col I is the empty boundary).
Match CCT rows to parsedConfigFile by exact case- and whitespace-sensitive DP-name comparison; return unmatched rows from either side as distinct categories.
fadcAutoReset parsed as a structured logic tree.
Parse the conditional Data Transmission Inputs subsheet: absent -> dataTransmission:null (valid); present-but-empty -> reject as malformed; present-and-populated -> dataSafetyLevels[] + outputDataTransmission[].
Contract: VTF-329.
Tests: extend Cucumber suite (happy / malformed / missing); Phase 1 features must still pass.

Summary: [BE-03] Baseline FCT Parser (FCT2 Archive, Project.xml -> ComAebMap)
Description:
Parse the FCT2 archive (Project.xml only) into the ComAebMap.
Identification: .fct2 extension + ZIP magic-byte check. Build CAN-segment membership from the Bp CanConnections chain; collapse MASTER/SLAVE redundancy and set redundantComPresent.
Expose chains[] with com, and aebs[] (dpId, dpName, evaluatedFmas[], acoIoExbs[] outputFma triplets, dtIoExbCount).
Trackplan XMLs ignored. Reject counting-head-output mode IoExbs. Security/resource limits per contract.
Two external error codes: FCT_TAMPERED, FCT_INCOMPLETE_BASELINE.
Contract: VTF-328.
Blocked on: exact 8 root filenames + 2 folder names (B3); SB 4.0.2 multipart override behaviour (B4); counting-head-output rejection error-code mapping (B11).

Summary: [BE-04] v2 Validate Endpoint and Coupled-Artifacts Gate
Description:
Add POST /api/config/v2/validate. Phase 1 POST /api/config/validate remains untouched.
Coupled-artifacts gate: both FCT and PDQ -> v2; neither -> Phase 1 path; only one -> HTTP 400 PHASE2_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE. tpf upload is independent of the gate.
userInput is upload-sourced: fctData + pdqData mandatory; four tpf keys (CFG_TROLLEY_SUPP, CFG_PARAM_TROLLEY_SUPP, CFG_RSR_TYPE, CFG_TYPE_PRTCT) optional.
Invoke the preprocessor and assemble the v2 response: validation_results[] (seven-field) + eight detail tables; detail-cell _expected sibling on mismatch.
Contract: VTF-330.
Tests: endpoint scenarios for all three gate states; v2 response shape.

Build the validate-time preprocessor: in-memory, stateless, constructed fresh per request.
Produce the Expectations JSON keyed (ADC file, block, instance, entry) -> expected value, derived from the FCT ComAebMap + parsed PDQ only. ADC files are validation targets and are never read as a source of truth.
Implement the three cross-correlation rules: project-block consistency (CFG_PROJECT_AEB / CFG_PROJECT_COM); dual-FMA consistency (RESET_TYPE / RESET_DELAY across CFG_SUPERVIS_FMA1 / FMA2); CFG_IP_SWITCH derivation from redundantComPresent.
Depends on: BE-03, BE-01, BE-02.
Tests: expectations-build scenarios; source-of-truth assertion (no ADC reads).

Gates all cluster stories (BE-08 .. BE-14). Depends on: BE-05.
Tests: lookup-mode scenarios; all Phase 1 rules continue to pass.
